secondbot.title: 🎧 Second bot (voice helper) — optional
secondbot.intro: An extra bot that recites in a second voice room when the first one is busy. It has no commands of its own: you keep using this bot's commands, and a member's request is handed to it automatically.
secondbot.step1: Press **➕ Add the second bot** below (you need the **Manage Server** permission).
secondbot.step2: Pick **this server** on the Discord page and approve the permissions.
secondbot.step3: Come back here and press **🔄 Check** so we can confirm it joined.
secondbot.step4: Make sure it can see the voice rooms you want (**View Channel + Connect + Speak**).
secondbot.not_joined: ⏳ It has not joined this server yet. Finish the steps above, then press **🔄 Check** again.
secondbot.ok_body: {{bot}} is in this server and online. When the first bot is busy in another room, a member's `/recite` or `/live` is handed to it: it joins **their** room and posts its own control panel.
secondbot.gaps_title: ⚠️ The second bot joined, but needs permissions
secondbot.gaps_body: {{bot}} is in the server but is missing: **{{gaps}}**. Give it a role with these permissions (Server Settings → Roles), or allow them in the voice rooms, then press **🔄 Check**.
secondbot.offline_title: 🟠 The second bot is in the server but offline
secondbot.offline_body: {{bot}} joined, but it is not running right now (the bot's owner needs to start it). Nothing is wrong on your side.
secondbot.none_title: The second bot is not set up
secondbot.none_body: This bot has no voice helper configured, so there is nothing to add. The bot's owner can set one up with `npm run add-bot`.
secondbot.footer: Optional — the bot works fully without it

errors.not_in_voice: ❌ You must be in a voice channel to use this command.
errors.not_same_voice: ❌ You must be in the same voice channel as the bot to control playback.
errors.no_permission_connect: ❌ I can't join your voice channel. Give me the **Connect** permission there (channel settings → Permissions).
errors.no_permission_speak: ❌ I can join but I'm not allowed to talk. Give me the **Speak** permission in your voice channel.
errors.connection_failed: ❌ Failed to connect to the voice channel. Please try again.
errors.busy: ⏳ The bot is serving the maximum number of servers right now. Please try again shortly.
errors.no_permission_view: ❌ I can't see your voice channel. Give me the **View Channel** permission there.
errors.voice_full: ❌ Your voice channel is full ({{limit}} users). Raise its user limit, or give me the **Move Members** permission so I can join anyway.
errors.stage_unsupported: ❌ Stage channels aren't supported. Join a regular voice channel and try again.
errors.bot_missing_permissions: ❌ I'm missing a permission in this channel (usually **Send Messages**, **Embed Links** or **Use External Emojis**). Check my role's permissions and try again.
errors.bot_no_access: ❌ I can't access this channel. Give me the **View Channel** permission here and try again.
errors.unexpected: ⚠️ Unexpected error. Please try again. If it keeps happening, send this code to the bot owner: `{{code}}`
errors.busy_sibling_here: ✅ {{bot}} is already reciting in the voice room you are in. Use it to control or change the recitation.
errors.busy_all_busy: ⏳ Every bot is busy right now (this one and {{bots}}), each in a different room. Join one of their rooms or wait until one finishes.
errors.busy_use_other: ⏳ This bot is already reciting in another voice channel. Use {{bot}} to start another recitation in this server.
errors.worker_busy: ⏳ {{bot}} is already reciting in another voice room of this server, and this bot is busy too. Join one of their rooms or wait until one finishes.
errors.worker_start_failed: ❌ {{bot}} joined {{channel}} but could not start that recitation. Pick it again from its control panel.
errors.worker_timeout: ⏳ {{bot}} did not answer in time (it may be offline or restarting). Please try again in a moment.
errors.worker_pending: ⏳ {{bot}} is already being called to this server. Please wait a few seconds.
errors.other_bot_in_voice: ⛔ Playback is not possible because another bot is in {{channel}} ({{bots}}). Please remove the bot from the voice channel and try again.
errors.join_in_progress: ⏳ The bot is joining a voice channel in this server right now. Please try again in a few seconds.
errors.fetch_failed: ❌ Could not fetch Quran data. Please try again later.
errors.command_error: ❌ An error occurred while executing this command.
errors.stream_error: ❌ Audio stream error. Skipping to next track.
errors.station_need_manage: ❌ You need the **Manage Server** permission to add or remove this server's stations.
errors.station_need_owner: ❌ Only the bot owner can manage public stations.
errors.station_name_invalid: ❌ The station name must be between 2 and 60 characters.
errors.station_url_invalid: ❌ That isn't a valid link. Use a direct stream link starting with `http://` or `https://`.
errors.station_unsafe: ❌ That link points to a private or blocked address, so it can't be used.
errors.station_unreachable: ❌ I couldn't reach that stream. Check the link works and try again.
errors.station_not_audio: ❌ That link is a web page, not an audio stream. Use the direct stream link.
errors.station_limit_guild: ❌ This server reached the limit of {{max}} stations. Remove one first.
errors.station_limit_global: ❌ Public stations reached the limit of {{max}}. Remove one first.
errors.station_not_found: ❌ Station not found. It may have been deleted already.
errors.pull_no_session: ❌ No bot is reciting in this server, so there is nothing to pull. Start one with `/start` or `/recite`.
errors.pull_already_here: ✅ {{bot}} is already in your voice room — no need to pull.
errors.pull_ambiguous:
❓ More than one recitation is running in this server: {{channels}}
Run `/pull` again and pick the room you were listening in with the **from** option.
errors.pull_no_free_bot: ⏳ There are still people in {{channel}} listening to {{bot}}, and no other bot in this server is free to come to you. Wait until a bot is free, or rejoin them.
errors.pull_resume_failed: ❌ I could not continue the recitation in {{channel}}. If you keep seeing this, check the bot's permissions in that room and try again.
errors.pull_not_allowed: ⛔ You cannot pull the recitation from {{channel}} because you were not just in it. You must have just left that room, or ask a moderator.
errors.worker_still_joining: ⏳ {{bot}} accepted the request and is still joining {{channel}} — give it a few more seconds before trying again.
errors.pull_someone_joined: ⏳ Someone just joined {{channel}}, so the bot stays there with them. Use `/pull` again to bring a copy to you if a second bot is free.
errors.pull_too_fast: ⏳ A pull is running or just finished. Wait a few seconds and try again.

misc.left_idle:
👋 I left the voice channel due to inactivity.
Type `/start` to bring me back anytime.
misc.radio_lost:
📻 The radio stream was interrupted and I couldn't reconnect, so I stopped.
Use `/radio` to start it again anytime.
misc.left_sleep:
😴 Sleep timer finished — playback stopped. Good night 🌙
Type `/start` to start again anytime.
misc.worker_joined: ✅ This bot is busy in another room, so {{bot}} joined {{channel}} and will recite there. Use the control panel it posted.
misc.worker_joined_nopanel: ✅ {{bot}} joined {{channel}}, but it may not write in that room or in this channel, so it could not post its control panel. Give it **View Channel** and **Send Messages**.
misc.pull_moved: ✅ {{bot}} moved to {{channel}} and carries on from where you were.
misc.pull_cloned: ✅ {{bot}} joined {{channel}} and continues for you from the same point; {{from}} stays in {{old}} with the people who remained.
